items.description: Optimus Plumbing (Pty) Ltd is a plumbing company that started in 2015, with its founder bringing more than 16 years of experience in the plumbing industry. The business handles plumbing installations and repairs, including fixing leaking or burst pipes, taps, toilets and radiators, as well as new plumbing installations for homes and businesses and corporate maintenance contracts. Its leak detection work uses technology to trace hidden leaks, and it carries out burst geyser repairs and replacements, including assistance with insurance claims. Solar and standard geyser installations, repairs and maintenance are also listed among its services. For blocked lines it offers high-pressure hydro jetting and electro-mechanical drain cleaning for sewer and stormwater lines, plus CCTV drain camera inspections that locate cracks, blockages, root intrusion and leaks. The company says it works with insurers, body corporates and property management specialists on claims and jobs, following SABS and SANS 10254 standards.

Orion Broking Solutions is a short-term insurance brokerage with over 40 years of experience in the short-term insurance industry. The firm describes itself as an insurance partner that protects businesses through tailored cover, from specialised liability covers to commercial and industrial multiperil covers, matched to each client's industry and risk profile. Services listed on the website include motor fleet insurance, commercial and industrial risks, motor traders and dealership insurance, goods in transit and transportation, construction and engineering risks, hospitality and lodges, restaurants, and luxury and 4x4 vehicles. Orion says its team provides full claims support and takes a personal yet highly professional approach with existing and prospective clients. The website invites visitors to view the services or request a quote.

Pansula Workwear sells workwear and safety clothing, and describes itself as a leading choice for workwear and safety uniforms in South Africa. Its online catalogue is organised into categories including workwear, PPE, medical PPE, security wear, reflective wear, rain wear, chef wear, jackets, casual and corporate wear, footwear, gloves and PPE accessories. Products shown on the site include rainsuits, safety boots, boiler suits, conti suits, dust coats, food industry clothing, canteen wear, disposable medical wear, lab coats, scrub sets, masks, first aid supplies and combat shirts for security staff. Items can be added to a quote, and customers can request a personalised quote for their workwear requirements. The website notes that orders placed online exclude delivery.

The Pretoria branch of Paxton Property Practitioners is part of the Paxton property group and operates from Celtis House, Block D, at Eastwood Office Park in Lynnwood. Its services include property management, body corporate management, financial management, street closures and business forums, commercial management, sales and letting, and property law. The website says the practice is an accredited and registered member of the Property Practitioners Regulatory Authority and holds a valid fidelity certificate. It states that it is registered with the Debt Collecting Council and operates trust accounts in line with section 54 requirements. Professional indemnity insurance is in place, the practice complies with IFRS for SMEs and the Companies Act, and it is audited annually, which qualifies it to act as a trust administrator. Office hours are listed as Monday to Friday, 07:45 to 16:15.

PCCM is a construction and maintenance company established in 2014. Its main speciality is the installation and project management of padel tennis courts across South Africa, and it also maintains existing padel courts. The company's other services include major industrial painting, including revamps and repaints for large industrial buildings, building construction, general building maintenance and waterproofing. The website describes PCCM as a reliable, quality-focused contractor with a balanced focus on construction, maintenance and court installations. Its industrial painting work is aimed at owners who want a revamp and repaint of a large building. The company invites enquiries through its contact page and offers a quote request for projects.

PEC Utility Management traces its roots to the PEC Group, which was founded in 1991 as Prevent Electrical Contractors cc, a specialist in electrical building maintenance and utility services in the Northern Gauteng area. PEC Metering cc was established in 1993 to add metering services, and in 2004 the business registered as PEC Metering (Pty) Ltd to support its growth. In September 2013 the group rebranded as PEC Utility Management, which the company says has since developed far beyond traditional utility management and maintenance. Its services include consumption management and conservation, EV charging, revenue management, sustainability consulting and alternative energy solutions, technical services, utility supply management and utility network audits. The company says BBBEE is one of its key strategic imperatives, and its about page describes an international identity alongside its work for national clients.

Pelican Systems supplies ceiling and partition systems and related building products for commercial and residential interiors, aimed at ceiling and partitioning specialist contractors. Its ceiling range includes suspended grid ceilings in white and black, acoustic ceiling tiles from Knauf Ceiling Solutions, gypsum and calcium silicate ceiling tiles, and flush plastered ceilings using JUMBO flush plastered grid. Suspension systems, special trims and accessories are also supplied. Partitioning options include drywall systems in 76mm and 89mm aluminium, plus specialist FireWALL and toilet partition systems. For doors, it supplies timber and aluminium door solutions for partitioning, including SABS-tested and approved fire doors. The company says its ceiling systems serve commercial offices, retail spaces, healthcare facilities, hospitality interiors, educational buildings and affordable housing projects.

This branch of The Specialists operates as a dedicated local franchisee offering pest control, cleaning and hygiene services in Pretoria City and North. The branch's website describes more than 30 years of cleaning expertise and says its cleaners are accredited, trained and fully equipped. Its divisions are pest control, cleaning and hygiene. Cleaning services range from once-off deep cleans to ongoing hygiene maintenance for homes, offices and commercial facilities, and the hygiene side includes washroom hygiene services and hygiene products. The site says services are tailored to each client's specific needs and comply with national hygiene standards. Operating hours are listed as Monday to Friday, 07:30 to 16:30, with Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays closed. The branch says it covers the wider Pretoria City area, including suburbs such as Akasia, Annlin, Arcadia and Doornpoort.

items.description: PixelPro Media is a Pretoria-based marketing and AI training business that describes its work as building brands, running marketing and teaching teams to use AI. Its three service areas are branding and web design, social media management and AI training. Branding and web design covers identities and digital experiences that show an audience who a business is. Social media management covers creative content, targeting and running social channels that build audiences and drive sales. The AI training is practical, hands-on instruction in tools such as ChatGPT, image generators and content tools, aimed at real productivity gains for teams. The company also runs public AI workshops across South Africa, and its website lists upcoming sessions at Blos Café in Pretoria, as well as in Tzaneen and Welkom.

items.description: Postlink Celtis Ridge is a franchised business launched in 2016 that offers printing and courier services. Its courier service sends parcels and documents anywhere in the world. Printing services include printing, scanning, typing and faxing documents of any size, along with canvas printing. The business also has graphic designers on staff, offers website design and hosting, supplies packaging materials and provides business start-up services. Its website says the vision is to be the best business support centre in the country, with the highest standards of integrity, honesty and transparency. The stated mission is to provide superior services, to go the extra mile for clients and to be the first choice of printing and courier provider in the industry.

items.description: Pretoria Gates & Garage Doors Automation installs, repairs and maintains gate and garage door automation systems for homes and businesses in Pretoria. Its gate work covers installation and repair of all types of swing and slide gate motors. Garage door automation covers sectional, roll-up and tip-up garage doors. Repairs and maintenance include fast, reliable repairs and preventative maintenance to keep systems running. The company offers emergency call-outs and says it responds promptly when a system is needed most. The website highlights quality automation systems, professional workmanship and transparent pricing. It invites customers to request a free, no-obligation quote for gate and garage door automation services.

Print Joy is a printing business that offers DTF printing and garment printing, along with corporate clothing, PPE clothing, corporate gifts and personalised gifts. Its display products include indoor and outdoor displays and display combos. It also handles vehicle branding, signage, business cards, flyers and large format printing. The company describes its approach as combining craftsmanship and creativity, and says every project runs from custom design through to the final print on modern printing technology. Its about page says the team aims to meet and exceed client expectations on each job. It describes its equipment as state-of-the-art printing technology operated by skilled professionals, and says it handles every project with enthusiasm from initial concepts through to the final print. The website offers a downloadable company profile.

items.description: Rainier Waterproofing is a waterproofing, painting and rope access specialist based in Pretoria, serving clients across Gauteng. The company says it has delivered waterproofing and painting services since 2001, for residential and commercial projects, new developments and renovations. Its waterproofing covers concrete roof slabs, pitched roofs, chimneys, box gutters and tiled balconies, along with metal roofs, showers and parapets, flashings, valleys, ridges, expansion joints, planters and water-retaining structures. Materials include 4mm torch-on, polyurethane, acrylic, liquid plastic, cementitious and bitumen-based liquid systems. Painting covers high-performance coatings for interiors and exteriors. Rope access is offered for hard-to-reach spaces. All work carries product-backed guarantees, and the company offers a free site assessment.

Realise Product Design is a product design business founded in 1998 as a design consultancy, which has since grown into design and manufacturing. Its process starts with research and concept development, then moves to detailed design refinement, CAD modelling and 3D printing, which it uses for prototyping and design communication so that form, fit and function can be tested early. The business later added injection mould tooling and plastic part manufacturing. It introduced direct-to-object printing eight years ago, which prints graphics, branding and functional markings directly onto plastic parts and enclosures. The website says the design offering is integrated with manufacturing, so a client can take a design from idea to a production-ready product. Services listed include printing, laser cutting, design, 3D printing and injection moulding.

Rebec Mas Group is a home care provider offering personalised care and treatment solutions for patients. Its listed services include specialised care, professional cleaning services and patient transport. The company says its caregivers are trained and vetted, and that its care packages are flexible, ranging from short-term visits to 24/7 support. It presents home care as quality care without leaving the home, with a comfort-focused, hospital-level standard of care. The business says it serves five provinces. Its website describes the approach as compassionate, confidential and reliable, and says it aims to help patients and their families navigate the care system and make informed choices.

RecruitCo (Pty) Ltd is a recruitment and staffing business and a wholly owned subsidiary of Workforce Holdings Limited, a provider of employment, training, healthcare, wellness and financial services. Its website describes bringing the elements of staffing together with a focus on compliance with labour legislation and equity transformation. The group's brands and divisions include IT search, Accotech for project-centric response-handling solutions, learnerships and apprenticeships, which places people with disabilities and offers skills training, and blue-collar, BPO, call-centre and offshore recruitment. The website says each search is aimed at finding the right candidate at the right time for the right job, driven by experienced recruiters.

Redento Events & Hire is an online party and event equipment hire business. Its catalogue covers chairs, tables, tents, catering, cutlery, glassware, crockery and linen, along with backdrops, carpets and party supplies. The site also offers combo packages and DIY packages designed for different types of event. Extras listed include a 360 photo booth, marquee lights and wooden cross-back chairs. Some items are hired by the hour, and the photo booth is offered in one- to five-hour blocks. Some products can be added to a cart, while others are added to a quote request, depending on the item. Popular categories are listed with stock counts, including 49 linen items, 32 chairs, 32 glassware items, 30 crockery items, 22 catering items and 13 tents.

items.description: Renda Business Consultants describes itself as a business growth consultancy. It works with business owners to identify growth challenges and provide strategies to scale up effectively, efficiently and sustainably. Its services are operational improvement and optimisation, which assesses business processes to identify underperformance, potential risks and new opportunities, and business coaching, which focuses on taking more direct action toward goals, managing time better and staying motivated. The firm's stated aim is to help owners improve efficiencies so they can enjoy more profits and more personal freedom. Owners who want to discuss their goals can book a call, which the website describes as obligation-free.

Retail Solutions is a Pretoria business that supplies weighing equipment and related retail products. Its scale range is broad, covering animal weighing, baby, carcass, counting, bakery, butchery, bench, floor, hanging and platform scales. Heavy and light industrial scales, laboratory and medical scales, pallet and parcel scales, portion and precision scales, printing scales, receiving and retail scales, veterinary scales and waterproof scales are also listed. Other product categories on the site are labels and till rolls, money counting, security solutions and CCTV cameras. Products include check-weighing scales and Ishida scales, and the website includes a bargain corner for used items. Its categories cover settings from butcheries and bakeries to medical, laboratory and industrial environments.

RLD Design is a manufacturer of premium stainless steel canopies and canopy accessories for pickup vehicles. Its range includes the Generation 4, Urban X, Hunter and Utility canopies, with a choice of ElectroLatch central locking or standard key-operated locking. The Generation 4 is described as rugged, dustproof and rooftop-tent ready, with toughened glass, concealed hinges, oversized push locks, large gull-wing doors, two gas struts per door, a positive pressure air vent and an integrated LED rear brake light on applicable models. The canopy has a minimum weight of 75kg and a dynamic loading capacity of 350kg, with an 80-micron powder coating finish. Accessories mount using a T-slot system. Canopy options are listed by vehicle fitment and cab configuration, including double cab, extra cab and single cab.

RN Inc. is a law firm that specialises in construction, building and engineering law. The firm says it is passionate about the built environment and regularly acts on behalf of employers, contractors, subcontractors and suppliers. The firm also handles dispute resolution on construction projects. In partnership with voluntary associations and professional and industry bodies, the firm presents training on the standard form building contracts, the principles of contract management and dispute resolution for stakeholders in the building industry, including the legal profession. Its website includes a team page and an option to book an appointment. The firm's office is at 272 Thatchers Fields Street in Lynnwood, Pretoria.

items.description: Rodtek Engineering is an engineering company that manufactures drilling equipment. It was founded in 2007 and describes itself as a market leader in Africa and beyond. Its products include RC equipment, DTH equipment, stainless steel equipment, casing, augers and drilling technology. The company says its strategic location and size let it compete with international suppliers to the mining industry, and it manufactures premium equipment with short lead times. It says it supplies some of the biggest drilling companies in the world. Together with sister company Thor Drill Rig, it provides turn-key drilling operations and equipment to customers globally. Its newer offerings include compact units with simple designs.

Rosslyn Tannery is a leather tannery in Rosslyn, Akasia, that produces wet-blue leather for local and international markets. Its products include wet-blue grain, wet-blue full substance, wet-blue drop splits, double butts and chrome-free hides. The company says its products are produced in accordance with LWG standards and customer-specific requirements. The website lists environmental sustainability, certifications, a company profile, a social feed and a gallery. Customers with technical questions, queries or requests can get in touch, and the company says its qualified leather technicians will assist. The website also includes an About Us section covering the company's story. Its address is 23 Stefaan Viljoen Street, Rosslyn, Akasia, 0200, and its contact section offers technical support through the company's qualified leather technicians.

items.description: SA Barn Doors makes handcrafted solid pine barn doors for South African homes and offers nationwide delivery. Its range covers standard pine barn doors, bi-fold barn doors and luxury custom barn doors, along with barn door rails and door handles. Customers can design their own barn door by choosing the design, the slats, the colour and the hardware, then adding it to the cart. The website describes the doors as premium solid wood and says they are handcrafted in South Africa. It also has a gallery and an order-your-own-design option. The site lists standard pine doors and luxury custom doors as separate routes, with frequently ordered standard barn doors available to add to the cart directly, and it sells barn door rails and door handles as accessories.

SA Labour Consulting is an industrial and employment relations consultancy based in Brooklyn, Gauteng, with extensive experience in labour law. It assists small and medium businesses across many industries to increase productivity, reduce workplace conflict, eliminate risks and reach their business goals. Its ensuring-compliance service measures how effectively an organisation's industrial relations processes and procedures meet relevant legislation. Staff management support covers probationary issues, performance management, misconduct, incapacity and grievances. Collective bargaining support manages the relationships between employer, state and employees, and helps clients deal with trade unions, bargaining councils and dispute resolution centres. The firm says it tailors its services to each organisation, because people are the most valuable resource in most environments.

Safspec International Services offers automated single-point lubrication systems. Its product range includes electromechanical and electrochemical single-point lubrication systems and an automatic oil level control system. The SAL Elite is an electromechanical system that operates fully automatically and independently of temperature. It uses an electronic drive unit, a lubricant canister in 60, 120 or 250 cm3 sizes and a battery pack. Discharge periods of one to twelve months are set with a push button, and the status shows on an LCD display with red and green LED signal lights visible from a distance. The website lists single-point lubrication of roller and sliding bearings, sliding guides, open gears, gear racks, spindles, shaft seals and chains as applications. Settings can be changed at any time, and the system can be switched off during long equipment shutdowns.

Samuel Pauw Inc is a chartered accounting firm offering accounting, tax and audit services. The firm was established in 1998 and was formally constituted as Samuel Pauw Inc in 2000, following a merger with another sole proprietorship. Its website says the firm has built a reputation over 20 years for maintaining high ethical standards and building long-term, win-win relationships with clients and staff. The firm is led by a Chartered Accountant and Registered Auditor who is its sole director, supported by four qualified professional accountants registered with SAIPA, an article clerk and administrative staff. It participates in the SAIPA Leadership programme by hosting trainees and uses standardised accounting, tax and audit software. The firm says it gives independent, unbiased advice and recommends what is best for clients rather than what is merely suitable.

Sans Souci Towing provides light, medium and heavy-duty towing and recovery services, covering everything from breakdowns to complex recoveries. Its listed services include specialised transport, load assistance and goods-in-transit support, and the website lists an emergency service. The company says its custom-developed SST App and Track My Tow client portal provide real-time tracking, accurate job updates and time-stamped event logs from dispatch to completion. Its stated mission is to provide reliable, efficient and safe towing and recovery services, using cutting-edge technology and industry-leading equipment. The website says the team follows strict protocols so clients receive a safe and well-managed service. It also publishes its fleet, branches, company profile and health and safety policy.

Sastel Packaging and Pharmaceuticals is a contract manufacturer of existing and new formulations, offering development, manufacturing and packing services. It specialises in health supplements, personal care products, CAMS products, foodstuffs and foods with added value. Its research and development team supports clients through the development process. Manufacturing and production covers the packaging of capsules, tablets and softgels, sachets, blisters, tubes and containers. Before any product development or production begins, a non-disclosure agreement is signed between the client and the company to protect confidential product and business information. A technical quality agreement then sets out responsibility for quality. The website states that the company is accredited and registered.

Saunders Manufacturing, Sandblasting and Powder Coating (Pty) Ltd is based in Eersterust, Pretoria. It specialises in sandblasting commercial and industrial products, removing mill scale, oil, rust and other surface contaminants, and it provides protective coatings for sandblasted products. The company manufactures and repairs custom steel commercial and industrial products such as tunnel grates, trolleys and truck beds. It also offers powder coating for commercial and industrial products. Its mission is to enrich the Eersterust community by training and employing local people in sandblasting and steel manufacturing, and it says it has trained and employed over 40 community members so far, with plans to grow. Its stated core values are integrity, diversity, honesty, trust, commitment to customers and constant improvement.

items.description: Sedupe and Metja Consulting (Pty) Ltd is a 100% black-owned and managed South African consultancy established in 2011. It provides consulting services designed and customised for small, medium and large organisations, and can partner with a client's existing management and staff where needed. Services include economic growth and development advisory, internal audit, risk management, corporate governance, digital forensic and investigation work, and forensic accounting and investigations. Internal audit work includes preparing three-year rolling plans, operational plans and audit committee programmes. The company says its client service orientation and professionalism ensure high-quality work that meets client expectations. It is based at Berkley Business Park in Highveld, Centurion.

items.description: Segoale Properties CC is a women-led estate agency established in 1996. It is registered with the Property Practitioners Regulatory Authority, the National Home Builders Registration Council, the Construction Industry Development Board and the National Association of Managing Agents. It is also a panelist of managing practitioners for the Community Schemes Ombud Service. The agency offers sales, management, maintenance, construction and valuation services across Gauteng, Mpumalanga, North West, Limpopo, Northern Cape and Western Cape. The company says it has served as a training ground for many estate agents and property practitioners who went on to trade independently. Its website lists properties for sale and to rent, a bond calculator, property email alerts and a service for listing properties with the agency.
